title: Greenberg's p-rationality conjecture
exact_target: Do multiquadratic fields of arbitrarily large prescribed rank exist that are p-rational, for each odd prime?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9400181 (AMR-093-0181). CC BY 4.0.
Y. Benmerieme and A. Movahhedi, \emph{Multi-quadratic p-rational Number Fields}, arXiv:2007.04864v1 (2020), Section 1, Greenberg conjecture, p. 1; Section 2, definition of p-rationality, pp. 2--3.
